name: Spicy "Jalapeño Popper" Burger Wrap with Grilled Bell Pepper Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and place in a large bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Coarsely grate cheese into the bowl with the jalapeño. Add ground beef and spices; mix with your hands until well combined. Form into 4 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, quarter, trim, and seed bell pepper. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with salt; toss to combine.
Once the grill pan is hot, add bell peppers and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and fork-tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the bowl used for the peppers. Whisk to combine the dressing.
When the peppers are done, transfer to a cutting board to cool.
Place burger patties on the grill pan and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and grill an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.

Using the box grater, coarsely grate cream cheese into a small bowl, then add chili-garlic sauce. Use a silicone spatula or spoon to soften and combine the cream cheese mixture, creating a smooth cream. Set aside.
Once the peppers are cool enough to handle, roughly chop and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside two leaves per burger and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Spread cream cheese mixture onto burger patties.
Pile lettuce leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, on each plate. Top with burger patties and tomato slices. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
